verdict.rationale: Evidence shows related personalization mechanisms — batch calls with per-recipient CSV data, cross-channel Memory that carries caller context, and Knowledge that lets agents answer from custom content — which together imply per-caller context injection, but no doc explicitly describes a 'dynamic variables' API parameter or call-time variable injection syntax. missing for 10: explicit docs on a request_data/variable-injection parameter at call start, and independent/hands-on confirmation that per-call variables actually personalize the conversation.
